title: Pointwise Jacobian identity on a C¹ chart (parent steps 1 and 7)
statement: Notation: ℝ^d = Rn d = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d); n := m + k; P := WithLp 2 (ℝᵐ × ℝᵏ), the Euclidean product, whose volume is the Lebesgue measure of the finite-dimensional inner product space P (instance measureSpaceOfInnerProductSpace); toLp = WithLp.toLp 2; Hᵏ = μHE[k] (applied to an arbitrary set it is the Hausdorff outer measure); Lᵈ = volume; normDet = LinearMap.normDet, applied to the underlying linear map; DF(x) = fderiv ℝ F x (the zero map where F is not differentiable); j : ℝᵏ →L[ℝ] P is the continuous linear map z ↦ toLp(0, z), in Lean (WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)) (j z = toLp(0, z) holds by rfl). For an open partial homeomorphism Φ from ℝⁿ to P: O := Φ.source, Ω := Φ.target, ρ := ψ ∘ Φ.symm. Statement. Let m, k, N ∈ ℕ, let Φ be an open partial homeomorphism from ℝⁿ to P such that Φ is C¹ on O and Φ.symm is C¹ on Ω, let ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ be C¹ on O and let G : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ satisfy (Φ u).fst = G(u) for all u ∈ O. Assume the flat Jacobian identity (FJ) for (m, k, N): for all linear maps A : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ, Γ : ℝⁿ → ℝᵐ, T : ℝⁿ → P and E : ℝᵏ → ℝⁿ such that T is bijective, (T v).fst = Γ v for every v, and T(E z) = toLp(0, z) for every z, normDet(A ∘ E)·normDet(T) = normDet(A ∘ ι_{ker Γ})·normDet(Γ*), where ι_{ker Γ} is the inclusion (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype and Γ* = LinearMap.adjoint Γ. Then for every u ∈ O: normDet(Dρ(Φ u) ∘ j)·normDet(DΦ(u)) = normDet(Dψ(u) ∘ ι_{ker DG(u)})·normDet(DG(u)*).
lean_statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (G : Rn (m + k) → Rn m) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ Φ.source → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 Φ.symm Φ.target → (∀ u ∈ Φ.source, (Φ u).fst = G u) → (∀ (A : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn N) (Γ : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] Rn m) (T : Rn (m + k) →ₗ[ℝ] WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k)) (E : Rn k →ₗ[ℝ] Rn (m + k)), Function.Bijective T → (∀ v, (T v).fst = Γ v) → (∀ z, T (E z) = WithLp.toLp 2 (0, z)) → (A ∘ₗ E).normDet * T.normDet = (A ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker Γ).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint Γ).normDet) → ∀ u ∈ Φ.source, ((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) (Φ u)).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet * (fderiv ℝ Φ u).toLinearMap.normDet = ((fderiv ℝ ψ u).toLinearMap ∘ₗ (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).subtype).normDet * (LinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ G u).toLinearMap).normDet
